caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic mug with a handle, placed against a plain, light-colored background. The mug has a multicolored surface featuring irregular patches of green, dark blue-black, brown, and yellowish-beige tones arranged in a mottled pattern. The interior of the mug is a light tan or beige, with shading indicating depth. The handle is curved and displays the same mottled coloration as the rest of the mug, with visible transitions between green, brown, and yellowish areas. The composition is centered, with the mug occupying the central area of the image and no other objects present. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name "ELISABETH JONES" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Large Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
